name: Marshal Marris
summary: Marshal Marris is the beleaguered military officer commanding the town watch at Lakeshire. Stationed near the town's bridge, he coordinates defense operations against the massive Blackrock orc invasion pressing down from the heights of the Redridge Mountains. With Stormwind's army absent, he relies on visiting adventurers to blunt the horde's advances.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Lakeshire stands on the brink of collapse, caught between the gnolls to the west and the terrifying military might of the Blackrock clan to the east. Marshal Marris oversees the guard line at the town's primary bridge, but his resources are depleted and his soldiers are spread impossibly thin. With the kingdom of Stormwind withholding royal reinforcements, Marris carries the heavy burden of keeping the township from being overwhelmed by brute force.

sections.title: Breaking the Blackrock Vanguard
sections.body: Recognizing that defense alone will not save Redridge, Marris orchestrates decisive offensive strikes against the orc encampments. He directs mercenaries to cull the Blackrock warriors, dismantle their shadowcasters, and ultimately hunt down Tharil'zun, the menacing commander entrenched inside the ruins of Stonewatch Keep. His orders aim to break the command structure of the orcs before an all-out assault crushes Lakeshire completely.

aliases: who is the guard at lakeshire bridge
faq.answer: Marshal Marris is the senior military commander in charge of defending Lakeshire. He can be found standing guard near the western end of the town's bridge, trying to keep the settlement fortified against hostile incursions.

faq.q: Why is Marshal Marris hiring independent adventurers?
faq.answer: The Kingdom of Stormwind has failed to send adequate garrison reinforcements to the Redridge Mountains, leaving Lakeshire's local guard hopelessly outnumbered. Facing gnoll warbands and an entrenched invasion of Blackrock orcs, Marris is forced to enlist mercenary heroes to carry out critical strikes.

faq.q: What threats is Marshal Marris fighting against?
faq.answer: While gnolls plague the outskirts, Marris is primarily focused on the Blackrock orcs who have seized Stonewatch Keep. These orcs, commanded by Tharil'zun and bolstered by shadow magic, represent an imminent existential threat to Lakeshire and the greater kingdom.

faq.q: Is Marshal Marris related to Nathanos Marris?
faq.answer: They share a surname common to the human kingdoms of Lordaeron and Stormwind, but no official record confirms a direct familial relationship between Marshal Marris in Redridge and the famed ranger Nathanos Marris from the north.

faq.q: What is Marris's plan to defeat the Blackrock clan?
faq.answer: Marris implements a war of attrition and decapitation. He directs combatants to cull the Blackrock infantry, gather magical components from their shadow magic users, and breach Stonewatch Keep to execute their leader, Tharil'zun.

faq.q: Where can Marshal Marris be found?
faq.answer: Marris is stationed in Lakeshire within the Redridge Mountains, positioned prominently along the bridge near the center of town.

angles.text: Marshal Marris embodies the plight of the rural Alliance territories, left vulnerable by Stormwind's political paralysis and forced to fight for survival on their own.
For humans of the kingdom, Marris represents the stoic, beleaguered frontier guard holding the line against the remnants of the Old Horde.
Marris appreciates straightforward martial discipline, sending capable front-line fighters into the jaws of Stonewatch to trade blows with seasoned Blackrock veterans.
